method: Actual unchanged Worker handlers and migrations, isolated Python sqlite3 databases with WAL, four persistent local SQLite connections and at most four concurrent Worker calls. Synthetic data never leaves local temporary storage. No HTTP network calls.
limitations: 10k/100k are seeded registered-account records, not simultaneous visitors or authenticated production accounts.
No common real auction, money, bank, delivery or server-account backend exists to certify at this audience.
Local Node/Python/SQLite timing is not Cloudflare D1 latency, capacity, RPS, mobile rendering or a DDoS test.
Persistent SQLite processes, WAL and OS caches differ from hosted D1. SQL CPU excludes Node but includes local SQLite work; batch wall includes locking.
No cold-disk claim: seeding warms caches. Cases are run serially; report p95 is a small bounded-sample descriptive statistic.
Node memory excludes Python processes; per-process SQLite peaks are reported separately, not summed into a claimed total. The seeding process peak includes fixture construction.
Approximate SQLite VM steps use a 1000-op progress callback: zero means below/coarser-than sampling resolution, not no database work.
Recorded database/WAL/SHM file sizes are one local snapshot; WAL checkpointing and connection lifecycle change disk usage.
